title: Mango cake near Rouse Hill or Stanhope Gardens? 100% eggless, from Riverstone
summary:
Mango cake near Rouse Hill or Stanhope Gardens, with no egg in it? Riverstone bakes it 100% eggless.

Mango is one of 15 flavours we make in 6 to 16 inch sizes. A 6-inch serves 6-8 and starts at $39.99. A 12-inch serves 25-30.

Order 2 days ahead and collect from Shop 8, Riverstone Shopping Centre. Free parking, and we open at 6am on weekdays.

It is a summer fruit cake. It should taste like the fruit, not like sugar. Message us with the date and the size.
